global_design_principles: Medical Trust through Color: Use the deep forest green as the anchor, soft sage as the supportive tint, and off-white as the canvas to evoke a natural, trustworthy, and calm medical environment.
Bento Grid for Mobile: Dashboard cards must not just float; they should act as a tightly packed grid of actionable widgets with generous internal padding.
Tactile Inputs: The OTP/Coupon boxes and form fields should have substantial height (min 56px) and subtle border changes on focus, offering physical 'weight' to the interaction.
Generous Negative Space: Avoid clutter. Text and cards should have ample breathing room.

SplashScreen.layout: Flex center, full screen, background color #FDFBF7
SplashScreen.logo_container: Circle with background #E8F5E9, padding 24px, border radius 9999px

CouponScreen.instruction_text: text h3, text align center, color #4A5D4E, margin bottom 32px
CouponScreen.otp_container: flex-row, justify-between, margin bottom 32px, flex wrap for 8 items

attributes: All buttons, inputs, and touchable elements MUST include testID (React Native equivalent of data-testid).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use standard React Native components ONLY (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, TextInput, ScrollView, SafeAreaView, StyleSheet). Do not use Tailwind/HTML elements since this is an Expo App.
Use standard StyleSheet.create for styling, translating the provided design system into React Native styles.
For the logo, use the paw print emoji 🐾 wrapped in a Text element as requested in the problem statement.
For the dashboard icons, you can use Lucide-react-native or vector-icons if available, or text emojis if icons are not installed.
The 8-digit coupon input must be split into 8 separate aesthetic boxes.
Do NOT use HTML elements like <div> or <span>.
Keep touch targets at least 48px (min 44px requested, but use 56px for inputs/buttons for E1 generocity).
